text: My husband raved about the Eggs Benedict so I had to try it. Well, if you are reading this review you must try it too! Wow, we didn't even consider eating elsewhere because they have the best breakfast around.
Love the food. Love the singing on Saturday nights. Great desert too! Oh love the takeout too!

Ate here again with my wife.  We both had 2 large overeasy eggs, three strips of crispy bacon(she) & two sausage patties(me), one bottomless cup of very good coffee, one order of Whole Wheat toast, one cup of great grits(southern style, nice 'n fluffy, the way they should be made...perked for 45 minutes+), & one order of pancakes (3)...for $20 (T&T incl).  AYSM?

All the waitresses(Melissa, Alexa, etc.) are super attentive, cordial, & efficient.  The decore is cute/interesting.  What a great place.

We Ordered a pizza for pick up and it was burned:( all the pepperonis were straight up black... I feel like it's a major bummer for the employee to see a pizza come out like that and instead of making another one, they just box it up and send it out. For $30, I was definitely disappointed. I would have preferred to wait another 25 min for a new pizza 

We ordered a half fritz half resa special. Other than the part that it tasted burned, the fritz was pretty good. Great meat to veggie ratio. The resa was not our fave. The chevre is really overpowering. 

I'm sure the experience would have been better with a better cooked pizza. I expect burned pizza with cheaper venues but definitely not with a high price parlor

Ever since I went to Japan when I was a teen I've been looking for the delicious melon bread I had there. I've gone as far as SanFran to try to find it. Then a friend's told me about this place and I decided to stop by. Low and behold there was the glorious melon bread (although they call it something else there). Their selection is amazing and the food is to die for. From their steamed buns to their moon cakes to their breads they have the best Asian baked goods in the area! The service is quick and they will steam your buns for you there if you want then nice and warm. This is a must visit location!

Delicious way to begin our day! This cute place hit the spot with their yummy lavender iced latte, berry tart, and chocolate hazelnut croissant. The staff was super nice and helpful in picking out the perfect baked good. They even gave my daughter stickers to keep her entertained. We sat outside on the patio under the shade and it was perfect!

Been here a few times as I'm local. Personally I think it's still open because they are close to the hospital and beach and offer strong drinks and drink specials....food has never been a fav here! Shepherds pie is terrible! Lots of cheese on top I believe is to cover the lack of flavor in the dish! French onion soup they offer could actually use more cheese and less salt! Friend had chicken wings that were over cooked and hard. Nicely asked waitress for another order and it finally arrived,after we got our bill! Yes,chicken wings were on it! After 6-8 visits here I've finally decided I won't go back even if the person I'm with wants to try it. Just not worth it.

Never had a problem here, I've been to other Taco Bells (always drive thru) where I have watched staff go directly from handling cash to making food, (and food poisoning resulted) not so here. 

It is what it is supposed to be: fast, cheap food.

I have spent a lot of $ here and I used Postmates to deliver tonight. 2 Postmates drivers had been waiting for over 2 hours for food. I tried calling and their phones were turned off. So I went up there. The female owner told me first come first serve. So I guess 2 hours wasn't enough time? Do you know how many times I have sat inside your restaurant? Do you know how many neighbors and friends I have brought to your restaurant? I use to live 1/4 mile away and would walk up there several times a week. Still live close and visit monthly, But if you order Postmates and aren't physically there then I guess you aren't a customer there? I guess I didn't matter? I will NEVER go into this restaurant again. During these times I have made an effort to only support local restaurants. In times like these people show their true colors.... and this one did. Unprofessional and unethical. 
Btw I don't like how your receipts show a percentage to tip the staff. It's tacky. And last but not least the owner is tacky. When I did walk in after telling me several times first come first serve she threatened to call the cops! Seriously? 2 hours with no food even prepared? Letting unsuspecting Postmates drivers there to wait for almost hours and were very rude to them. I immediately left bc I heard sushi and cops don't mix. If I could call the food cops on her I would! Bad ownership!

Have you ever known something was going to be delicious before it even touches your tongue, that is how I'd describe the two dishes we tried there (Tortellini and Gnocchi), really really tasty, great location and great service.  Me and the wife stayed in Santa Barbara and with all the outstanding food we still came here twice.
The salmon with risotto and vegetables is probably one of the best meals I have ever ate! Not really a salmon fan but the sauce makes this meal for me ! Incredible!

Brunch at The Court of Two Sisters was delicious! The eggs benedict was pretty good, and I loved their hollandaise sauce! I also got a side of grits and an iced coffee (which is just hot coffee poured over ice instead of a cold brew or previously made iced coffee--it was pretty good though). I would look at the menu beforehand because if you're not a big seafood fan, you might not love all of the brunch options. This place is a little bit priced but great for celebrations!

Probably the best bagel you can get in Delaware county. Highly recommend stopping by if you're in the area. Bring enough home to eat fresh and stick the leftovers in your freezer. You won't be disappointed.

Side note - they are still open during this pandemic, and someone was actively wiping down the door handle as soon as someone came in or left. They are doing their part, and so should you. Keep supporting these businesses during this tough time!

We went here for NYE, as we are from Ohio. I know the sales team was soo annoyed with us, because i continued to call to see what the NYE menu would be. The venue was immaculate! Lighting was perfect and we had a table right in the center for the perfect amount of sharing. my favorite part of the menu: the amuse! I had never tried oysters and the start of my night was just that! I enjoyed that everyone gave us the perfect recommendation and the steak was *chef's kiss*!

This place is one of my families favorite places to go especially in the summer. The owner is very nice and so is the rest of his staff that work very hard. I have gone here multiple times and taken food to go and have never been disappointed! As a European finding good and delicious food outside of Europe can be sometimes challenging when you want a taste of home and this place does just that. They offer so much variety from Gyros to Pork and some amazing desserts as well as vegetarian options there is so much to choose from!! I especially love coming here in the summer because there is outdoor seating! I would honestly recommend this place to any family, friend, or colleague!

I just left this place in Marlton.  I called ahead about wait tume and was told there was no wait I put my name on the wait list.  No reservations allowed.  Well I get there 10 minutes later and check in with host and my name is not on the list and there is an hour wait.  The manager said "you couldnt have called here we have an hour wait"  Turned to leave and he said they would honor my call.  So we waited.  While waiting I wanted to make sure I did call the right store and I did.  When i showed the manager I did call, he said " I'm honoring your call,"  He is not a happy guy.  I should have just left but we stayed.  Burger came out wrong no bacon and had pickles ( dont like pickles).  Popeyes chicken sandwich is way better then what I had.  I had to stare down the waitress, chatting with the next table, to get the bill. Manager came to apologize about the order but never checked back to see if everthing was ok even tho he past us about 10 times.   Not sure I will be back..

This is my favorite restaurant in the world. The food is absolutely amazing. The quality is exceptional. The staff has been always friendly. I have been coming to this restaurant since it opened. Every single time I go, the food is absolutely fantastic. The quality never diminishes it is perfect every time! It is truly the best restaurant ever. I am so glad that some things don't have to change!

The absolute best pizza in this area! Their potions are very large and it is basically 2 meals in one with leftovers. Their thin crust pizza is absolutely delicious and also available for pickup incase you'd rather enjoy on a night in. I will say their prices are a little high but I have never minded as it's the best pizza and I have enough leftover to spread the love into the next day.
Overcooked fish, small portions, slow kitchen, $3 extra for creamy blue cheese dressing- really?

We visited on 4th of July, and while the waitress was kind enough to be honest about the limitations of their AC to keep up with their oven, it still really seems unwise of the restaurant to keep an uncovered 1,000+ degree oven in an open space with no plan B for mid-summer, and inadequate AC. It was really uncomfortable, and we were far from the oven - what about the poor staff? They looked miserable. 

The pizza was good and the server made a solid effort, but my second piece of weird experience about this place was that my friend, who has well-managed celiac (she's had for 15+ years) shared two gluten-free pizzas with me. The server was very knowledgeable about what was okay for a GF person, which was great. But after us both eating the same two gluten free pizzas, my friend (and not me) was kept up all night with intense nausea and vomiting, which set in about 1 hour after leaving. Of course, this could be due to other factors - but the server did say there's always a chance of cross-contamination, and to be honest, I'd guess the staff by the oven was way too overheated to be careful that day.
This place is super tasty! I love the spring rolls and pad Thai! The inside and decor could use some work but the family is super nice and the food hits the spot.

Went to the Ballwin location last night and it was 10X better than our previous experiences. Celine was our server and she was awesome. The Prime Rib was really good and my wife had the Sirloin and she really enjoyed that

Great atmosphere, the interior design was cool and the service was okay. Three of my friends and I came in on a Saturday night around 7pm and waited  for about 30 minutes to be seated. The food was good in general. However, it did take a while for the meat to come and our server didn't check on us AT ALL while we were eating. We waited even more and had to ask other servers for our server lol. He finally came and we are currently waiting for our meat AGAIN while I'm writing this review (we got our grill changed and the new grill is turning black - that's how long we are waiting). The server for the table next to us came regularly and it seems like our server has another table across the restaurant - which I don't understand why couldn't they arrange the servers to serve tables in the same area. 

I do like the food and the price was reasonable ($25 for all you can eat) but the waiting game is simply ridiculous.

We were there to celebrate 3 birthdays. Disclaimer: make reservations, this place gets packed fast. This particular night, the AC was broken or not working, it got super hot! We were all dressed up and using our menu to fan ourselves the entire nite. 

Our server, bless her heart was sweet but I could tell she wasn't happy? She looked upset which made me feel weird asking her for anything lol. She never came back to refill our drinks, i was drinking friends water to replenish. 

The food options were good but not great, very high in calories. I ended up getting the seafood chowder which was really good! I'd eat that again. 

Amidst all the problems we had during the nite, it was still a fun nite with friends. Will i be back.. most likely not!

This location was awesome! The parking situation is not the best since this plaza is crazy busy at night. I got the half pound bbq chicken, green beans, coleslaw and corn bread. I wasn't a fan of the coleslaw but the rest was good. I will return the service was super fast, ordered, food was ready before I could get to the drink machine and they were busy.

Based off the reviews I read, I was expecting a long line/long wait. There was neither. The food was delicious and came out quick. Portions were way more than enough. I was worried about parking (we have a truck with a 25ft trailer behind it) but was able to park on the road, so it worked out nicely. If I come back through Nashville again, I will stop back in.

We started coming in just for amazing falafel a few months ago.  We ended up with being offered a taste of something they just whipped up and friendly conversation. The owners truly try to make you feel welcome. Between the good food and kindness, you will want to continue coming back like we do. There's a lot of vegan options too.

Decided to pick up food from here for the first time. I gotta say I'm never ordering food from here again. Front desk person looked at me and sat down back facing me. A cook actually was stocking plates and he asked me if I've been helped. Once I got my food, the fries were old, hollow microwaveable cheese sticks, undercooked pot stickers, uncooked wings, there was a hair on my potatoes skins, and last but not least I ordered a large platter and gave me a small. They only decided to add more of one item in the platter and called it a day. I then called, they picked up and immediately hung up my call. I've also complained to corporate about it but I doubt anything will chance. Please don't waste your time coming here.
Nice big place - food was quite good and reasonably priced. Would have given 5 * - but for the absent minded waiters - taking their own sweet time to serve.  Good place to go have Indian food :))

Had my arm twisted to try this place again and wound up going back twice in the past 4 months. It was near empty both times and our hostess was also our waitress. I've never had an issue with their waitresses. They are sweet girls. Both times I went back it was near empty and that could make or break your experience. A full shop is a no go. 

While the sushi does still fall apart at times, the taste has gotten so much much better than when I originally went where everything tasted the same and so bland. I don't want to not give them credit when they have definitely improved to where I'd love to come back again. 

Their hot teas are wonderful, but I won't order from their bar after the first time so I can't say anything to that for these past two visits. 

The taste of their appetizers are a hit or miss depending on who is doing the food, I guess because the 2nd time I went, in December 2019, the pork katsu and seaweed salad were amazing quality and the 3rd, in February 2020, they were just ok. I think they can improve even more with consistency in their food prep.

so, we recently ordered takeout, and they accidentally didn't give us two of our soups we ordered, but, they have fantastic service. i called back and the manager was very nice, and gave us our soup (in and extra large bowl) and a complimentary cinnamon coffee cake (like the ENTIRE cake, it wasn't a slice), and we didn't have to pay delivery fees, the delivery guy was fantastic and very nice as well. fantastic! if we could rate them more then five starts we would, at least 6+ because of their service!

Rude and slow! They never have my order right and there's always missing something. The last time I was here they forgot my large fries. I asked for the manger he claimed to be "Mohammad Ali" well whether he was being funny or not he offended the wrong customer! I'll take this up to corporate and that's the last dime they will get from me!
Very rude and very long wait times. Very very unprofessional I called asking for wait times and got hung up on I just really wouldn't come here ever again!

Was really happy to bump into this place yesterday. The two guys working there were friendly and helped me cause I'm crazy indecisive. I ended up getting the turkey and cheddar panini (y'all, it's real carved turkey on an herbed ciabatta...), iced tea, a piece of pound cake and the apple tart. Everything was great, especially the sandwich, which I ended up having to share even though my mom and sister weren't hungry . I'll be back!

Such an awesome find! Food is delicious, the people are so sweet here. They have a great set up and it's my new go to breakfast spot. Very fortunate to have this place in the area, there aren't many like it. Simple, unassuming, and great food.
Terrible management and bad service. We won't be coming here anymore. I'm very disappointed in the manager and lack of professionalism.

Get the damn soup dumplings. period. 

They're unparalleled to most, and you won't even want to bother with anything else on the menu -- you'll just want to save more room to stuff additional dumplings in your face. My fav is the spicy pork. 

To be honest, in reading other reviews, it sounds like the rest of the menu might fall short anyway...

The lines will be LONG, so don't wait until you're hangry to check this place out. Also consider placing a takeout order (and eat it IMMEDIATELY) or trying to snag a seat at the bar. This experience isn't going to be an incredible dining one -- it's going to be about the deliciousness you'll experience at a great price.

The wait staff here best accommodates smaller groups - I would stick to a smaller party.

Take a bubble tea to go.

First time to Nashville and a friend recommended The Pharmacy, we were not disappointed. Loved sitting outside enjoying the scenery in the outside eating area. Burgers and drinks are a little expensive but we enjoyed the food.

Great for masochists. My first impression was when a hostess ran into my sister who was sitting down. Accidents happen but what irritated me was the lack of manners. She was completely unapologetic. I was stunned at first but quickly turned into laughter when the hostess turned around to shoot daggers at her.  As if to insinuate, she (the hostess) was entitled to some apology from my sister (the customer). We should have left then, instead we chased our losses. After waiting an hour for a table, we thought maybe the food will be worth it. It wasn't. I ordered the bacon burger and my sister ordered the bbq burger. The waitress asked how we would like them cooked. We both said well done. Our burgers came out to us about 45mins later. I was starving at this point and couldn't wait to dig in. I sinked my teeth into a large mouth watering bite. I almost puked. It was like sucking on pennies. The meat was raw. The burger was literally dripping out of my hands and onto the plate. My sister cut her burger in half. Same deal, raw meat. We wanted to leave. Of course we wouldn't see the waitress again for a another 20mins. When she swung by to ask how everything was, we told her the burgers are not cooked. What she said next compelled me to write this review. I don't write reviews often. Usually it's only when I receive exceptional service. However, her response to "the burgers are not cooked" was so astonishing, it deserved to be documented. As she leaned over the table to gaze at the

Ordered via their app for pickup and it was prepared accurately, properly and on time. 

There is no buffet at this time and I actually DO miss their lunch buffet. 

Also ordered their cookies and it was nice. 

Staff could be friendlier, but restaurants running under the tRumpPlague, I'll give this a pass.

THE best muffuletta in the city whether they are the original or not.  (Who cares). The shop also sells interesting and some obscure items.  The sandwich is huge and salty so unless you just want a lot of salty food, a half or splitting a half is recommended.  If you are eating inside good luck.  But I will say people eat and run so be patient.  Or walk somewhere with your sandwich treasure.

Boise Pie is still open with modified hours during the COVID crisis, thank god! I called them and placed my order a couple days in advanced. Check their website for order info! Best chicken pot pie EVER. Marionberry pie is to die for. YUM!

Someone had told me to check this place out as for breakfast, I might come back once again for some shrimp and grits which i heard is one of the favorites. I want to say that service was top notch fast, kind and direct. The prices are not as low as expected as the food being served doesn't require a lot of work. Their avocado toast was quite simple and a little expensive for as simple as it was. It's cute little place in mid city. Their donuts were good and fresh. The reason for the low rating is that it does not blow me out of the water. I could eat same or better at home for a lot cheaper or at a different restaurant with better preparation and same price. Food presentation was nothing crazy, tomatoes were sliced to thick.

I ordered Margherita pizza.  I found it to be small.  Could have had more seasoning.  Very plain.  Limited menu.
Atmosphere was ok.

My mom lives in St. Petersburg so Im always looking for a good new spot to try when I visit. Larry's is always a stop for us when heading to the beach. There's so many great flavors and I love the sample of the mini donuts when you walk in. 

When planning a gender reveal I needed last minute pink and blue donuts and they were able to make my dream come true! The donuts are a must have - very fresh.

Dr. BBQ,  I was excited to try it out and recently I had the opportunity.
The restaurant was interesting inside nice decor.  We were seated upstairs in two cozy seats overlooking the bar.

The waitress was slow to come over and greet us and slow to bring us some water. After I decided on what to order I went to drink some water and noticed this awful smell coming from the water glass.  I had my dinner companion check his water glass and found the same awful smell. The waitress had left a pitcher of water on the table I smelled that water and it smelled clean.  When the waitress finally came back I let her know the problem and I guess she did not believe me because she picked up my glass and smelled it and then walked away with my glass.  She never bothered to change my companion's glass of water.  When she returned she brought me another dirty glass filled with water. She then did not return for a long time to take our order. 
When the food arrived I ordered the brisket (Brisket is my favorite) Although I had never had it at Dr. BBQ I figured it would be awesome.
I was very disappointed that I ordered 8oz of Brisket and at least 4 oz was fat.   
So this experience was a fail !!!!  It's way to pricey for BBQ to have dirty glasses, bad service and bad food.
They have actual outdoor dining with heated seats. The food takes awhile to arrive, but the staff is friendly and the food is always good. I feel safe eating here.
Great food, friendly staff.  Unique and classic menu choices to satisfy any pallet, substitutions have never been a problem.

Damn good burgers!! Admittedly haven't gone to far off script ordering burgers for delivery at least 6 times. Cooked well seasoned properly they are delicious. I will update if I order more goodies from the menu just now with Covid been doing a lot of home cooking. Been inside to get takeout while picking up sushi a couple doors down. Very nice clean place with good atmosphere.

I love the salad bar here for lunch. The ingredients are fresh. It is clean. The service is also great. There is always a selection of soups as well and pizzas. The breadsticks are delicious. The salad bar is $6.99 with a beverage. 

This place also has a separate Keto menu if you are into that.

One star for each piece of tofu, that came with my meal Haha . Foreal though, This place is a Cool little family spot, full of flavors. This is my 2nd time eating at little ninja. I must admit, I'm bit confused as to why they'd charge $1.50 extra for tofu. I'm a vegetarian and This is the first restaurant I've been to where There's been a up charge for tofu. From my Asian eating journey, tofu has been the cheapest protein option for me at restaurants.
With that being said, The Flavor of the tofu was really really good And crispy  , yet there were ( 4 tiny slices with my meal.) it seemed like I was served less than 1/4 block of tofu. 
To be real. It was disappointing when the tofu came  out. Underwhelming at the least. I often eat at Asian  restaurants and order a tofu Meal. it usually comes with a whole block of tofu. The egg rolls were delicious and The service was friendly. the restaurant also has a chill vibe.
Food and service are on point! If you want fancy, go somewhere else. If you want really delicious food, this is your spot

First timer here!  Was looking for something different so I found this place on yelp.  It had mostly good reviews, some not good, but wanted to see for myself.  

I loved all of the options they gave for online ordering but was surprised they didn't have an option for onions on the chili cheese dog ‍. Oh well, no big deal.  Ordered and the food arrived in the time frame they estimated...BONUS for a Saturday night!  The driver was nice, the food was fresh, so far so good.  

Now for the food.  I ordered the "Pelle" sandwich, an order of regular fries and for good measure...the chili cheese dog (sans onions).  The Pelle was an absolutely AMAZING blend of flavors.  The avocado was perfect with the smoked Gouda and toasted sesame seeds...this is seriously quality stuff at prices you could normally expect mediocre for.  The fries were good...I personally like fries a bit crispier, and I'm not a fan of the chili cheese dog simply because the chili is more sweet than I like.  But it was on a thick, fresh roll which if saltier would have balanced it out well.  

Even though the fries were just good and I didn't like the chili cheese dog, I'm giving 5 stars just because my issues are really just a matter of different tastes.  The Pelle hit it out of the park and is well worth a 5 star review all by itself!  Everything though was clearly quality ingredients made very well.

Great food and even better service !!!!! Our waiter was so kind and accommodating. We ordered spring rolls, general tso chicken, lo mein, fried rice, and a half duck! 
Everything was awesome. Definitely recommend :)
Best Pho in Edmonton. Addicted to the spicy beef. Love the deep fried wontons with Vietnamese coffee. Always super friendly. Support local!

I just got my first order from here and I have to say I was disappointed. I order the Thai green curry with shrimp, and I have to say I was disappointed with the shrimp themselves.  They were very small, and there weren't very many of them at that.  The curry itself and the vegetables were very good, but I was just surprised the the quality and quantity of the shrimp, particularly at that price point. I will certainly try out some of the rest of the menu, but I was disappointed.  I've been meaning to try the place for a while.

Never get food correct, drive thru is a nightmare, and service is poor. Multiple times I've gone here and they get the order completely wrong and the employees have a bad attitude. Just this location is poor, other locations for this establishment are usually great. Avoid this particular location.

One of the worst experiences ever! Waiting over 30 minutes for them to serve the food and find out they don't even have what we ordered. So we sat there for 30 minutes for nothing. Our flight was now less than an hour away and now have to try to find something else to eat at the airport. All we get is a I'm sorry!

We went to Louies with a good sized group after sledding. We called in advance and booked their private room. We chose menu items ahead of time. Everyone loved it! Best Lasagna ever. It was all ready for our hungry group. When we walked in the aroma was wonderful and the meal that followed was fabulous! Excellent service as well! It has a homey comfortable atmosphere. I would not chance one thing! Thank you Louies! We left full and happy.

We had a great time at Marker 39! The staff was extremely warm and friendly. We started at the bar, where they have a great selection of wine and beer. For dinner we got the "Cuban Pork Crisis" and a grouper dish that was on special that night, and both were incredible!! I would highly recommend this restaurant.
Absolutely the best Thai food I've had in years! The chef is an artist! Extremely flavorful food. They do Thai, Chinese and American food and they do it all very well! Highly recommended!

Good Indian food (any Indian food) is hard to find on the north shore. Made a special trip over for some tikka masala, dal and korma. Well worth the trip. Good prices, very friendly owners, and it was really good!

This family is crushing it! Emmett  family who raises their own rare breed of cattle in the same area.. 100% grass fed healthy beef. Had the Amy Bitner and Spicy Cowgirl. Everything on the burger was delicious and thoughtfully put together. You could tell the fries were hand cut and were fried to order. All sauces by MFT were spot on as well! Also thought the price was pinpoint for the quality. Do not waste any time and hit these guys up! The parking lot setup seems odd but that's what makes it unique. You will not be disappointed!
Some of the best food in town. The employees are hardworking and make this a community staple. If I can't dine in I get takeout weekly.

This is a great find! Sushi burritos were really tasty and fresh. My son and i tried a couple different sushi burritos and then he went back for another round. Nice friendly staff, no beer.  :-(  We will be back again and again....

The Happy hour here is excellent. The bottles of wine are like $12, which is awesome! Great selection too, not just a couple of house bottles. The food is consistent, the atmosphere is nice and the service is always top notch. The frozen drinks are also really yummy. I also really like the brunch here. Great spot on the Avenue!

If I could give this place -100 stars i would, i saw what it looked like to be the owners son dig through his nose while he was putting the peppers on my pizza, it was quite doughy cold and mushy and the owners son asked for a 10 dollar tip just for making my pizza  which he wasn't even good at he was quite aggressive, i also ordered a calzone and it was literally frozen in the middle, it gave me FOOD POISONING im looking forward to sue this joint !! its ridiculous one of my kids has autism and he had nightmares about the pizza, overall frozen food, overpriced, badcustomer service  and a petty owners son (the teenager).

Omg. Sooooo happy to have found this place. Been in nashville for 6 months and occasionally crave my moms cooking but don't have time to make it. So when someone told me there was a Puerto Rican restaurant here my eyes opened up and i go so excited. So here i am enjoying a good homemade mofongo, pastelillo and kola champagne. My heart is full. (And soon will my stomach) thank you to the owners for bringing this to nashville, thank you to the lady that helped me when i arrived. It smelled and felt like home. The food was great and appreciated the fast service. I like the fact that you have food ready to go and others that are made to order. It all looked delicious. Consider me a fan. I will definitely be back. I have to try everything on the menu. Thank you Merengue Cafe .... You have made me smile today.

I had the lamb gyro lunch special with lemon potatoes. The gyro was delicious! I wish the lemon potatoes had more lemon flavor but they were still delicious. The staff was nice and I got my food fairly quickly to make it back to work on time.

HORRIBLE ! I'm going to corporate about my experience ! 
Got there around 9:40pm . Kelly Was our server . Girlfriend was either High or REALLY high .  We ordered our drinks , 10 minutes later , got them ( 2 cokes )  ordered our food , 23 minutes got it ..  Boone's wings were Hard , never got a refill , The table that came after us got their STEAKS BEFORE US ! The Manager was too busy Watching the game to even notice the horrible service ! Never Again !

Greek's is my all-time favorite pizza. I don't know what it is that makes it the best, but it's so good.

I first discovered Greek's at the village near Ball State campus. There used to be a location at Southport and Stop 11 but it closed a few years ago. I happened to be in the area of Southport and Bluff and knew I had to stop at Greek's since it had been a few years since I've been.

If you want a deal, check out the daily specials. We got a medium 2 topping pizza and an order of breadsticks for $10.50. 

The breadsticks are drenched in garlic butter, but they're not too garlicky. The pizza sauce is a little sweet. The white pizza is delicious too. I haven't tried anything but the pizza and breadsticks yet, but I bet the pasta, shells, and cinnamon breadsticks are delicious too.

They do have delivery and carry out. They also just recently added online ordering at this location. I live outside the delivery area which is probably a good thing. The Southport and bluff location doesn't have any patio seating but my carry out experience was pretty easy. The only issue I had was that my quoted service time was an hour after I ordered around 11:30am. They were open and didn't seem overly busy so I was confused why I had to wait so long for carry out. Still worth it though!

While getting my car inspected at Sciacca, I decided to pop in to get a snack for lunch. They have plenty of food on the menu but I was drawn to the crab cake sandwich and order it with lettuce, tomato, and light mayo. My interactions with the staff was decent and the place is nice and welcoming. They have a lot of tempting snacks and candy near the register so kids would love this place. Even though it was lunch time, it wasn't very busy surprisingly. I also found the pricing to be very affordable. I might recommend this place if someone is looking for a decent quick bite to eat.

Hands down deserves 5 stars for excellent customer service. Even with a 45 min wait for our table, we felt valued. So tired of brunch places with staff who can't get off their high horses in the surrounding area, just because the places are popular. This place has a relaxed friendly vibe even when busy. I ordered a vanilla Frappe and hubby ordered fresh OJ and both were fantastic.  He even got a refill on the OJ at no extra cost. The food was fantastic and we left feeling satiated  both from good food and good service. We are coming back again, and hope to have the same experience next time! Highly recommend giving this place a try.

The CRG does it again. Shut up and take my money! 

Think of this place like a hipster chipotle or a mexican Fresh Kitchen. 

We ate here on 9-22-19 at 11:30am. $28.25 got us a bowl, quesadillas, a dip trio, and a drink. I spent about an hour this morning memorizing what I wanted cuz' I hate being some annoying noob clogging up the line at a confusing place like this for the first time. The man who took my order did not ease my anxiety because he made me repeat myself twice for each ingredient, was unfamiliar with the ingredients, I had to remind him of ingredients, and was generally bewildered. Maybe it was his first day? I thought I was prepared but this dude made it so stressful. 

I had the $9.91 "all in" bowl and chose the chilled super greens and avocado rice for the base, the sweet potato mescla and black beans as the veggies, steak and orange chicken for the proteins, cotija cheese and sour cream for the "Mexi things", and I have no idea which sauce I got but it was yellow and very mild. The bowl was fantastic! Very fresh and full of nutritious quality ingredients. I give this bowl 5 stars! 

The queso was warm and heavenly. The salsa is a strange color ( like orange transparent barf) but it tastes phenomenal. The guac is fresh and full of big chunks of avocado. The chips are a little on the thick side but enjoyable.

I'd rather go to FK honestly but this place was really good.

Attached to the Grand Hyatt hotel right on Tampa Bay, Oystercatchers had a terrific view of the water and a nice intimate outdoor deck overlooking it.  Sadly, this was late January and the sun was well set by our 6PM reservation so we didn't see any of it, but we were assured of the marvelous view by the staff and other diners.  Happily, the food was no disappointment and the ambiance and service quite made up for it!  My colleagues and I started with their Grande Seafood tower, 3 large trays filled with oysters (New England provenance - which amused us as we were from RI - MA Wellfleets and CT Bluepoints), Gulf shrimp, big stone crab claws, and a (Maine) lobster.  It also came with domestic caviar (a bit blander than the Russian sturgeon, however, but still a nice bougie treat).  The accompanying sauces were good too, with a spicy mignonette and a surprisingly good mustard sauce for the lobster.   I followed that with a local fish - pan-roasted gulf grouper - which was excellent and meaty, big chunky pieces.   It was accompanied by a solid goat cheese risotto. Their desserts were also well-executed; we shared an outstandingly good peanut butter cup in phyllo pastry (very flaky!); an excellent key lime pie, and a good creme brulee.  Next time we'll time our meal better to coincide with a spectacular sunset, and then I'm sure I'll raise the rating up to 5 stars!

Wyliepalooza Ice Cream Emporium is a fun ice cream shop, decorated with bright colors and cool names for their ice cream like the James Brownie. They have a private parking lot behind the shop. They also flavors for days. I counted over 24 (that they put out) over three freezers. They have many other flavors that they can rotate in. I got two scoops of the key lime pie and it was delicious. They serve Chocolate Shoppe Ice Cream, or at least that is what is all over the containers. They have some cool signature sundaes that I hope to get back and try soon.

The place is clean and the entire staff was very friendly. This is a small local shop and if you are looking for a place to satisfy your sweet tooth, look no further.
Best Acai Bowl in Tampa Bay! I am a vegetarian and have eaten at ALL the other bowls in South Tampa. The texture, quality, and freshness is superior to the rest. LOVE THIS PLACE!!

Cute place tucked beside Bravo in Willow Lake Plaza at 86th and Township Rd. Looks like it was previously Eva's Pancakes and looking at pics on line the decor is much the same. Very busy, able to seat around 90 to 100 people. Wide range of Breakfast / Brunch / Lunch items. I ordered Eggs Benedict with the poached eggs poached firm. Husband ordered Ham and  Cheese Omelette. Mine with a side of Hashbrowns and his with Hashbrowns and Feench Toast. Eggs Benedict was very good. Hashbrowns were typical shredded potatoes. Ham and Cheese Omelette was large and full and the French Toast was very good. Service took awhile but they've not been open long as Mornings Breakfast and Brunch and I feel like the staff is still learning. It was also a Holiday today. We will be back to try other items on the menu. They are priced very reasonably and right now if you do Yelp cash back they are offering 15% back. That's the highest I've seen so far.

This place does not get enough attention for the quality of food it serves. So happy I stumbled upon this restaurant and it's korean and japanese cuisine. I would say it is more japanese with a korean fusion. Their place is quaint and not too big but the food is amazing. We tried the nabeyaki  udon, the spicy salmon special roll and the spider roll. The combination of seared and raw fish is delectable. They serve fresh and the service was great. The price is a little more but definitely within reason. I think this would be a nice date spot as well. I am ready to try more from this place. I highly recommend!!

A trip to SoCal is not complete without an Acai bowl! This was a great Acai bowl because I am very picky with the Acai, I've been to many places where the consistency is watery but this place did not disappoint! Also, they were very generous with the serving size! If you're in SB I would take a stop here!
Stopped in here by chance and was pleasantly surprised. The royal po boy was huge and tasty with fried green tomatoes and grilled shrimp.
This place has totally changed with new management and great friendly staff and food. Must Try !!!

The service was good and the staff was very approachable and nice. With this being said however, the area of the restaurant that was specifically for families smelled HEAVILY of cigarettes. This seems extremely counterintuitive if you ask me.

If you want authentic Mexican food come here!!! My girlfriend and I love hot sauces and salsas. This place has the best of both, but the food was soo good we didn't even focus on the sauces. So unusual for us, but the pico was homemade along with the sour cream. You can tell. We over heard a older couple complain about "dry tortillas" but honestly I didn't think they were. We had 3 tacos, 2 with Asada 1 with chicken. The chicken was flavorful, but not my favorite. ASADA WAS AMAZING. The asada has great flavor and melted in your mouth. We are definitely going to make us this our new go to spot. We also read the reviews on here before arriving, and I would say that this business is still new but working really hard to just provide great quality food. Be patient with them.

The family were craving stir fry lobster and scallions so we did some research and decided to order it here since we had their dim sum and soy chicken couple weeks ago and it was delicious. We ordered 2 lobsters, shrimp fried rice and beef lomein. Everything was yummy and of course I had to get the stuffed tofu skin for the hubby. Great food and staff was friendly. Will be back soon!

This place is a must if you are in Bywater on Friday Saturday and Tuesday from 5 to 9. The tacos are great and they are very reasonably priced. All the tacos are three dollars besides the pork which is two dollars, I have tried the fish, brisket, and fish which are all pretty delicious and they are all topped with a coleslaw. They have some great salads as well! There homemade drinks are very refreshing. It is a very cool setting down an alley and if you are not looking for it you definitely will miss it 


This place Is amazing I am definitely a regular. There is another regular I have seen a couple times and the workers are so sweet gave him a free taco and they really get to know  customers and you can see they treat them like family! They also have a vegan option that is off the menu on top of there veggie options. This time I got a burrito and it is huge and delicious like always! 

Update: so happy they have a way right now to order (May 2020)...currently text in orders it's Venmo payment (refer to there Facebook page). It was super convenient.  Always have the best burrito/tacos! The best local gem!

This is my go to place anytime I'm in Santa Barbara. Great ambiance and a great staff. Super knowledgeable and also so welcoming. The food is always amazing and I love the local dishes and ingredients inspired by the region. The Santa Maria tri tip is a favorite and my go to. It never disappoints. They also take social distancing protocols very seriously, which I appreciate.

This place was a big disappointment. When I first went there everything was great. Now I know why it took me a year in half to go back. First of all the waiter or owner was very pushy. He was pushing us to get the tea he was obsessed with tea. When we finally gave in he bought out the tea in a wine glass half full for $4.95. For the price I thought it would be in a pitcher. Then he insulted us for putting sugar in the tea and to me had no flavor plus he told other customers about us and the sugar. Then he kept hanging around us and asking how the food was we had no privacy. The food was very good but the service was creepy. Also the waiter kept pointing to expensive items I will never set foot in there again. This place is for people who like to get ripped off.

We did a takeout order for our sales team for lunch. They did a good job keeping it organized since there were orders for about 10 different people. 
This was a tough one to rate for me because I do not eat sushi often, but some of the guys on the team eat it often and they swear by this place. 
I ordered a spicy tuna and spicy crab poke bowl (I believe "poke" translates to whatever is nearby the bowl and not actively crawling away in Chinese) and it was good. They offer a ton of different sauces, but it was kind of like information overload, so I went with the sweet Thai chili sauce and it was fine with my combination of ingredients. 
I tried the pot stickers, but they didn't have a lot of meat and seemed over cooked (see my review of Kwok's Bistro for comparison). 
I also tried a jackpot roll. It was ok, but I still don't feel like I hit the "jackpot". 
I tried a spicy tuna roll that one of our folks ordered, but it wasn't great. It wasn't spicy and was described by one of our team members as "bland". 
Again, I'll admit I'm not a sushi expert and the best sushi I've had I caught myself and a legit chef prepared several dishes that evening (shout out to Chef Cosmo Goss!) and it was by far the best I've ever had and this wasn't very close to that if I'm being honest. Our team ate up what they ordered and I'd give it 4 stars based on their comments, but based on my rules I could never go 5 due to the P word (Pepsi) as their drink of choice in the restaurant. I dropped it down

This is my go to 'fast food.' Not a week goes by without an order of chicken pho with rice noodles. Delicious! Everything I've ordered is good, but I mainly come here for the pho. My daughter and I love it! It's light, flavorful and filling - and they don't use msg! Fresh spring rolls with shrimp are great, too.

The staff and food was just spectacular for our wedding guests. We dined outdoors in the courtyard under hanging lights that created a perfect ambiance. The cocktails were fresh tasting and very unique (the Hurricane was delicious!) Every single course, served family style, was fresh tasting and delivered to our tables with perfect timing. Everyone loved the crispy brussel sprouts and squash salad. My favorite was the braised ribs. Justin was our server and took great care of us all night, while the owner, Kurt was fantastic too. Our guests appreciated all the Covid safety measures. We will definitely come back!!

Wouldn't recommend . If you do get something make sure it's fresh . Really disappointed on this place I go here all the time but today not only did they messed up my order they also called a liar over the phone

Scottish Arms is an STL gem. It was a staple of the neighborhood it is in before many of the other trendy spots came along, and is still rocking and rolling every time I go in. I have been many times in the last five years I have lived here, but this time was extra special, since it was NYE. We walked in for dinner, had no trouble getting a table without a reservation, even though it was comfortably full, and to top it off, there was a four person group singing Scottish carols and other cheery songs to ring in the Scottish New Year, which happened at 6pm Central. 

The food, drinks, and service are always great, and the space is very dynamic since they have a front and back indoor area, coupled with an outdoor patio that is fantastic in the summertime. 

The one downside is limited options for vegetarians, but you can get by. I usually engage my flextarianism when I come here, because their scotch eggs are THE BEST. My husband always happily gets the pot pie, which can be surprisingly hard to find on menus in STL.

Check 'em out!

We ate inside, the employees were doing a good job with masks, etc.  It was our first time eating here, so we asked a lot of questions and the staff was very friendly and helpful.  The food was great!  We all ordered different chicken tenders.  For sides: the parm garlic fries, regular fries, Mac and cheese were all great.  The beans were good.  They have good fountain soda as well.

My wife wanted to try the Classic Chicken Sandwich Combo. I usually buy hockey puck cheepo chicken sandwiches from whoever as I'm always on the run. She had the Classic Chicken Sandwich Combo w fries and fruit punch. I had the sandwich solo. Loved the size, texture, taste and soft bun w real dill pickles. Fries above board tasty. Ordered inside. Staffed with focused ready to please employees. Very good service experience. Dining room closed due to COVID prevention so we had a picnic in the parking lot. Life hands you lemons make lemonade!

School is starting around the country so here's my quiz for all of you boys and girls ready to learn new lessons.

WHAT COLOR of cooked eggs do egg whites create when the eggs are cooked over medium?  Actually any time egg WHITES are cooked.

Ok, so I gave a hint in the capitalization ... WHITE.  Well, our waitress didn't get it even when repeated told that the order was egg whites she kept staring at the all too yellow eggs and said, "do you want me to take them back?"  OF COURSE .... YES ... that is the bonus element on the quiz ... serve the wrong food and the customer doesn't want it because they want what they ordered.

Of course, the good ole UNCLE HERSCHEL's breakfast combo (I went with the fried catfish) didn't have the prerequisite eggs and she asked the same question ... "should I get you the eggs?"  OF COURSE ... I ordered a breakfast with eggs ... oh by the way the meal is also supposed to have grits and the sausage gravy should have a temperature above cold so yes please HELP ...

So, she walked away ... until the family connection arrived (Apparently this franchise has some element of nepotism protection happening.).  Mama bear said she would take care of everything.

And, as we wondered why one meal didn't have the fruit and sausage and were left guessing which were the two regular coffees and which was the decaf it was decided this experience didn't deserve our cash but of all the times ... someone PAID IT FORWARD and paid for our breakfasts without telling us

If it weren't for the fantastic views, the place would be a 3 star. But being that it is a rooftop bar and the view is spectacular, we are sitting at a 4 star. The drinks were good, but not great. And the food was adequate, but nothing to really write home about. The oysters were actually pretty great, but everything else felt safe and lackluster. The drinks were average as well, but this is still a great place to meet friends or someone you are trying to impress because of the great service and atmosphere. Make sure you make reservations otherwise it'll be pretty difficult getting seated.
Outdoor dining and it was windy the night we were there. My husband's steak was good and the portion is just enough. I particularly liked the rice pilaf. It was flavorful!

We definitely waited awhile because it was New Years Day, so I would go earlier if it's a weekend if you are going for dim sum. We enjoyed the menu items more than the dim sum, with the wonton soup and pan fry noodle being our favorites. However, they have limited dim sum options, and they only had 2 carts going around the whole place.

This place is tucked in a strip mall off of Binford Blvd. my first time ordering from this place, I opted for takeout. I love the delivery window they have that you can walk up to after parking. The customer service was great, and we promptly picked up our order. I tried the Wood Stock pizza, Dough Buds, and Hip Hop salad. The salad was fantastic, with very fresh ingredients. I absolutely loved the dough buds and all three sauces. The pizza topped the cake, it was so good. I'm definitely adding this place into my pizza rotation!!

Amazing from the moment they lured us in with the apple struddle sample to the very last bite! After we were seated, they started us off with a complimentary cinnamon danish that was absolutely delish! We then ordered the mushroom omelet that came with potatoes. Light, fluffy, with the perfect amount of cheese, mushrooms, and bacon. Upon arrival, I was so excited to dig in that I forgot to take a picture of the full plate. We cleaned the plate, finished my FREE coffee and then had to place an order to go after seeing the bakery case. 

Definitely recommend this place for the excellent service, amazing food, and incredible price point.

This is the best Authentic Mexican food I've had in Florida. Home made tortilla are excellent, steak is marinated, and the rice is amazing! They also have reasonable prices. I live in tampa but will drive to Clearwater just for their tacos.
This is a great chick fil a! Always so helpful and nice. Hard working people when there is a rush of people. I never leave disappointed!

If you like sushi, this is the place for you.  Of all of the sushi restaurants in the greater New Orleans are, they serve the largest pieces of fish.  Other restaurants have been reducing the size of the fish increasing the rice to the point that you can barely taste the seafood.  This restaurant has restrained from doing the same.  That is why it's is my sushi restaurant to go too.

Delicious coffee and lunch options! My husband and I stopped in here for a quick bite with our 4 month old and were pleasantly surprised by the great breakfast and lunch menu. I had the curried chicken salad which was super yummy and likely the best chicken salad I've ever had! Beyond that the bread tasted freshly baked! The service was warm and friendly and when I asked for a hot mug of water to heat our babies bottle they were incredibly accommodating. The space is really cute and they have several tables for 2 and a few for 4 plus. The coffee was delicious as well and they also had several fresh juices, smoothies, and pastries on site. Great spot!!

Spanish NOT Mexican despite the name. I was honestly excited about ordering mole...but it's a Spanish restaurant. Having been to Spain I can say it's quite authentic but with a much better beer selection. Order the happy hour specials and was pleasantly surprised. Quite large portions for specials. Didn't finish the fries. Everything was well balanced.
awesome awesome awesome! great sushi, great service, and some of the best desserts in town. for an intimate and upscale dining experience, woojung is the place to eat!

To start off they have a lot on the menu. I ended up going to with Hot Chicken Grouper. The rest is history. The fish was delicious and full of flavor. The potatoes were some of the best tasting, full of flavor potatoes I've had anywhere. There was butter at the bottom of the to-to plate and it tasted amazing putting the potatoes in it. I would recommend it to any seafood lover. Try Hook's Seafood Kitchen when you get a chance, it won't disappoint. Try ordering online and picking up, so you don't have to wait for it.

the staff and service was good however my boyfriend and i had found black stuff floating in our drinks, then had proceeded to ask for new drinks, which aso had bugs in them. at that time the waitress could not offer anything that would come from the soda fountain, meaning water too, because it supposedly had not been cleaned, which was why there was bugs in it. But that is nasty, and we will not be returning due to this.

Perhaps I just don't like Israeli food.  Had dinner with a friend a few weeks ago.  I had a side salad, which had so much vinegar in the dressing that it was inedible.  We shared the rice and chicken dish for 2.  Another disappointment.  Very little chicken, and all dark meat.

Tried the restaurant again with Sweetheart, and was equally unimpressed.  We will never go back.

When you think vegan you may think tasteless. This is not the case here! The menu changes seasonally and everything I have had is delicious. Save room for dessert. You can sit at the bar or window seats of the dining room is full. My only feedback for management is to cook the roasted broccoli a bit more. Twice I was there it was too close to raw.
Great quiet bar. Classy ambiance and good drinks. Was a welcome break from the noisy bourbon street crowd.
I definately will be back.  I had the snoots and all I can say is damn!!  I'm from Memphis so that says a lot in itself.  I'm a very tough barbecue critic.  This is a must stop bbq joint.

I can't always justify spending almost$11 for breakfast but my chicken chipotle avocado and egg wrap with a blueberry  and peach smoothie was delicious. The morning drive through speed has improved tremendously. The only thing better than my sandwich was the customer service and smile from Micha. He's awesome!

I've been there twice. Overpriced - food is "okay" -not worth the price they charge -service was bad BOTH times (what's the odds of that happening); definitely not worth it.  There are definitely better options. Service alone is a reason not to patronize this establishment-

This is our second trip to this location since the closures of restaurants.  Bahama Breeze has done a fantastic job accommodating guests during the curbside to go and limited seating.  They are always friendly and the food is delish! Hot & ready quickly. The staff and management have an organized system to deal with the current laws because of the pandemic.

Deeeelicious. That's all I can say. We had the Avocado rolls, they were absolutely wonderful. We also had the French dip and it was perfectly cooked. There was also pizza and a Chinese salad involved, and I was completely impressed with not only the food, but also the service. Biscotti's is the place to go If you're staying at the hotel.

Cold food !!! Then the staff was very unfriendly. When I asked for extra cheese and bacon for my order I could literally count the pieces. My ribs were cold and I was there on time to get my food and waited 16 minutes more after they said my order should have been ready. I also got a kids burger with bacon that was undercooked and the burger was dry! The manager offered more ribs which were BURNT and covered in sauce. The bread was also hard and burnt as well. I got more of an attitude rather than a friendly "I'm sorry let me make this right." Then to offer me a free appetizer was a joke!!! I spent $30!!!! Just to come home and throw this food in the trash.

Excellent food service and location! Priced moderately and just off ig the main drag I think you will enjoy your visit. They have outgrown there space so once full capacity indoor seating is allowed, be prepared for long wait times and parking us an issue. 

At last check they did not have outdoor seating so best to order ahead for carry out and enjoy elsewheee
Great food brought to a great location. We had 15-20 guests and nothing but great eats for 2 days!!! Highest recommendation!
We tried this place coz it was close to our Hotel and  we were glad we did! Food was delicious. The waiters were so friendly and attentive:) we would eat here again!!!

Excited to see the restaurant open its doors to customers today! The food truck has been my favorite Thai food in town for many years, so it is good to know I can satisfy that craving seven days a week now at their new restaurant location. The food is amazing, as always, and a few new items on the menu were a pleasant surprise.

I've been here a few times before a while back and it was nothing memorable however I came back Roy with my sister and wow I was impressed. We ordered the botana camarón as a starter and it was so fresh and delicious!  Our entree was the Carne asada tacos and they were so well seasoned and also delicious. The flavor is so authentic. Great tasting chips and salsa not that crap from other places like Chili's. I recommend and will be coming back more often.

I hesitate to review this place because it is so damn good I want it all to myself...Firstoff, if huge portions of mediocre fare that you can get just about anywhere else is what you're looking for, go elsewhere. The food here is decidedly unique, adventurously creative and utterly delicious. The menu is limited. Get over it, everything on the menu is fantastic. The portions appear small, but they are not, they are perfectly portioned for ultimate satisfaction without gluttony. It's not cheap. So what, it's worth it. 120%. Ruben and his staff are absolutely top notch, drinks are as unique and tasty as the food and the ambiance is casual chic. We. Love. This. Place. Check it out. I recommend the cauliflower appetizer and whatever their fish special is. Their risotto is the bomb as well. Thanks Ruben and TBS team!

We always have a great time at Kyle's and we love seeing pics of Kyle and all of his projects all over the restaurant! This family really cares about each and good food 

The burgers are, no doubt, where it's at, but I also love their salads and chicken sandwiches. The ingredients are always fresh and delicious! 

I recently saw that they have a crispy chicken sandwich now and I can't wait to try it! I asked the cashier if he'd try it yet and he is a big fan! You don't get a better review than that!!

They're ice cream cones always look fabulous too! I haven tried one yet, but once the weather is a little warmer, I'm all in. Here I come!
My new favorite spot in Santa Barbara for brunch! I loved their croissant! So flaky and when you break apart can see the multitude of layers  I will def come back here next time I'm in town!
If you're looking to chip your tooth on a bagel, this is the place for you. Bagel was ROCK hard. Couldn't even rip it with my hands.

Current best duck house in Philly. They've been there forever. Very small, take out only. Wonderful selection. Duck giblets or beef tendon in 5 spice, slow steamed duck wings, duck tongues, roast pork and pork belly and more. The duck itself is the least fatty roast duck I have found. Prices are typical, low for the organ meats. Ting Wong is great and you can sit when there isn't a pandemic on, but Siu Kee is a much more nuanced kitchen.

Just finished their special "Christmas Dinner for one" (but ordered two!).  What a GREAT IDEA (offering dinner for one) considering the smaller gatherings this year, the number of people eating by themselves, and other restaurants offerings that were for "four to six" people.  It was an OUTSTANDING MEAL that not only included two servings of meats (smoked Prime Rib & Chicken Tenderloin roulade), but Green Beans in mushroom bisque, Potatoes in butter and cream, and Garlic Thyme stuffing made from some unusual bread (Gambino's).  On top of that, they provided a Sangria cocktail, and killed it with homemade Pecan Pie.  These people (the owners) are great.  Can't wait to go back and dine on their great patio this spring.  Not only are their Hurricanes great, but if you go on a Saturday, their Ribs are EXCELLENT.  Try the Wings for an appetizer and you won't go wrong.

I've only been to Panda One the once, just the other day. I only went in because I have been jonesing for some sort of Asian food, for ever-so-long, and there we were, my son and my sister buying themselves burgers from Carl's Jr,  me being told that no Chinese food places are going to be open this time of night, or, probably at all. And, I peer out the window and see the sign, "Open", point it out, "They're open!". My heart swelled with hope, desire, dreams of possibilities ... You know, the usual things the potential for good Asian cuisine bring out in one.  Shortly thereafter, we were there, I was asked if I knew what I wanted by a lady who had manned the cash register, I asked for dumplings, she asked if I wanted steamed or fried. "Steamed." , I replied.  Haha   Okay, that's enough of that. The price was reasonable, especially considering that, when we got home, I found out their dumplings are about twice the size of most restaurants I have gotten them from. They also tasted fresher, healthier, more flavorful and came with a lovely sauce. 

That's all it took. One order of dumplings and I am hooked.

My coworker took me for my first time today and I was very impressed! I ordered the Buffalo Chicken Sandwich and it was delicious. The friendly staff even suggested some add ons and I am SO glad I listened to them. They know what they're talking about! There was a long line when I walked in but it moved very quickly due to the speedy service.

So we were in downtown St Pete for an event and wanted to grab some Thai food for my friends birthday. We searched up the nearest locations and came across Bangkok Thai Restaurant. A quick scan of the yelp reviews and we were confident we had selected a great choice. The place was located right off of Central Ave literally steps from where we had parked. Upon entering the restaurant we were warmly greeted and the restaurant looked clean and nice. The wait staff and hostess were very nice. I couldn't decide on what to select so I asked my waitress for a suggestion. My friend decided on the Panang duck and I decided on a crispy chicken dish. I so wanted to like this place but unfortunately the food was mediocre at best and the food didn't have that fresh and authentic taste that I always get when I dine at my favorite Thai places. I did appreciate that they brought my friend out a complimentary dessert when I shared with them that it was her birthday. If I visit St Pete again for Thai I'll try out another spot.
This McDonald's is advertised as 24 hours but it is consistently closed before 830PM I don't know if management is unaware but this McDonald's is closed by the time sun is down every night.
Service isn't great - but the food is yummy!! I'd totally recommend visiting this restaurant. I had the chicken bowl which was delicious.

Seriously this place is THE BEST soup and sandwich spot in town. If I'm in the area I know I'm going to end up here for lunch. They have a great selection of local craft beers to try and their soup warms my soul. Love this place!

This was a very neighbouring experience. Soon as I entered the small store, I saw to left and right of me, what looked like pictures of the staff family and friends as well as celebrities who have visted Koch's deli. 


I also saw the menu on the wall and they decided to name their hoagies after Philly Schools such as the Temple or Penn hoagie. They have this Special K hoagie which has potato salad, corned beef, turkey, pastrimi, swiss cheese and russian dressing. I was gonna try that but I figured I'll start basic and I got the gobbler which had all turkey meats, veggies and russian dressing. It was delicious and huge! you definitely can't finish it in one day!

Overall the staff was super friendly, the guy that made my sandwich was down to earth and he did a good job with explaining their selections.

Prices are a little steep but worth it. It's a treat you give yourself, I pretty much paid about 16.00. So if your in the area come to Koch's deli to grab a unique sandwich and have a unique sandwich experience.

My friend and I stopped by for a quick brunch and were delighted at the quality of food and diligence of service. One thing we genuinely appreciated was that the waitresses had a system where you had to mask up to signal that you were ready to order or needed something at the table. This provided an extra layer of safety, while also allowing for people to enjoy their dining experience. The grits were fluffy, cheesy, And downright heavenly. The best I've ever had! I ordered a toast with thick crunchy bacon, smothered in mushrooms and sauce, while my friend ordered a savory crepe stuffed to the edges. We will be back to try more menu items!

Great beer and wine bar with incredibly friendly staff and an impressively varied beverage menu. They offer their dozens of draught beers in every size from 4-20oz, which allows you to really hop around the taps (pun intended) or just settle in with a favorite. The food was all very good, but I do wish the menu offered more entrees. However, if you're feeling a charcuterie plate, this is the place to go!

This is my favorite place to go for lunch! Great sandwiches, soups, and salads! Cozy atmosphere with great service and great food. Their pizza is fantastic for dinner too! Overall, one of my favs and worth the wait if there is one!

Today I tried the Bonnie and Clyde, and it was super delish! This place is very Tucson, always fresh and woman owned, so if you've never been, it's time to give them a try! The Pretty Boy Floyd, Tucson Tuna and Meatball sandwich are also all wins! I honestly don't think you could go wrong though :)
This is such a great little gem in Medford great service, great margaritas great food! I highly recommend The passion fruit margaritas!

My friend and I visited recently and it is easily now my favorite place in all of Philadelphia. It is very clean and classy with chandeliers and plant decor. We got a booth and a chair table, but we noticed other larger groups had enough space to huddle comfortably around a full table. Our waitress was very patient and quickly showed us to a table. She even recommended their most popular drinks when we were having trouble choosing. Very very attentive staff. 

The menu features many types of teas (hot/cold) where you could also adjust sugar levels. They have fruity teas, milk teas, and healthy teas. The dessert selection was also very diverse, but cakes dominated it. We didn't order this, but there were also small meal options, like sandwiches.

Presentation was lovely! The teapot and matching set were very delicately ornate, though a little heavy to lift. The teapot sat upon a candle-lit warmer. Everything was plated like art.

We ordered the Tropical Oolong tea (guava, passion fruit, mango) and a Chocolate Raspberry Sorbet to share. A pot shared between two friends was definitely the perfect amount. We had about 3-4 cups each and it was very light/fruity. It came with a sugar pot. The sorbet was very fruity and the mousse was rich, all pierced by few pocky pieces. (Note: The chocolate cup is dark chocolate. Ask for a knife to cut it because it was cold and a little thick, but very delicious.) It sat on a plate over mango syrup with fruit chunks and whipped cream on the side
Awesome Deli. This is place if you are looking for Indian wraps, patties and much more. Love this place.

We were referred here, and thankful for the referral! We had 2 dishes: chicken biryani and a vegetable curry with garlic naan. Plenty of food for 2 people, even took some home. 
Super frosty & cold beer stein that was a great addition to our cold Indian beer: Taj Mahal beer.
Next time we are in Reno we will eat here again.
Service was perfect, zero complaints, only accolades. 
Clean restaurant.
They followed covid (over the top ridiculous virus) mandates to perfection.

Cool concept and friendly staff, but the food does not live up to the hype. Came here on a Friday night around 7:45, so Monell's was getting ready to close. We sat at a table with a family of seven, so the dynamics were a little weird. We sat down and had cornbread and biscuits, as well as broccoli salad and cole slaw, all of which were pretty mediocre. Then came the big feast of fried chicken, fried catfish, BBQ ribs, and stuffed manicotti. The fried chicken was so disappointing for my first meal in Nashville because I've had better much fried chicken in the Northeast. Everything else was ok. We also had mashed potatoes, turnip greens, green beans, and corn stuffing. The meal finished with banana pudding. Nothing was spectacular, but for $21 per person (excluding tip), it was a great deal and a cool experience.

Very good service. The food is incredibly tasty. We ordered sancocho, mofongo, beef, goat, rice and beans. They serve a lot of mofongo with lots of chicharrones. The goat comes directly from DR. I highly recommended.

On our recent trip to Tampa , me and my husband went to this tiny restaurant at a corner seeing the reviews . 5 star rating totally justifies it for the amazing quality and taste of food . We had cilantro hummus , falafel bowl with rice ! The lady there was sweet enough to let us taste all the hummus flavors . Portions are good enough for tummy to fill! Falafel was the best we had till date !
I love this place. The food is amazing and wholesome and reminds me of home. The chutney and pickled onions are delicious!

Amazing food! And incredible service! Group of 10 easily accommodated .... Gnocchi And stuffed mushrooms were so good!! Pizza off the charts! And the Best chicken parmigiana I have ever had!! Our waitress was very quick and efficient and friendly making our first time  experience worth the 5 star rating! My husband and I shared a very nice bottle of Malbec and my sister had a glass of House Merlot- both of which paired well with the food.  We ended the meal with cappuccino and dessert .... the desserts are all made in house... we had 4 kids with us and I'm pretty sure each of them cleaned their entire plate as well!! I would highly recommend if you are looking for a nice Italian meal even if you have children!

Our family of 5 ate here for a late lunch,  around 330 PM.  They were hopping!  We ordered the arch lux, miraletta, Frisco,  cheesesteak, kids chicken tenders, and just a pain cheeseburger all with fries.   One order of sweet potato tots.  

We also got some homemade oatmeal cream pies, they were HUGE and delicious!!

I tried several of the sodas, all tasty!!

So mine was the arch lux.   It was the biggest and messiest burger I've had in a long time.   But it was so delicious!!  

The fries are seasoned with a slightly spicy salt,  and served with mildly spicy and tangy dipping sauce. 

The chicken tenders were based with something spicy, so my daughter wasn't a fan.   They were tasty though if you're OK with spice.   She opted for a plain burger instead. 

The other sandwiches were enjoyed by the other members of the family.  No one had any complaints.   They all said it was very tasty!

They are only accepting card for payment right now,  no cash.   Also,  masks are optional.   

Plenty of seating inside and out.   

10/10 would dine again!
